title: JANUS Linear A R3B-1 alternate editorial overlap freeze
purpose: Freeze which alternate-editorial documents overlap the existing JANUS document universe and reserve a disjoint scientific holdout before transcription strings, sign sequences, candidate identities or prior near-misses can influence document selection.

identity_only_document_inventory.rule: The inventory may use document-level bibliographic/layout identity only. If transcription-bearing content is necessary to decide whether two document IDs correspond, that document remains UNRESOLVED and is excluded from the collision-free overlap freeze.

identity_bridge_rules.bridge_key: A source-neutral document identity key frozen from catalogue/document naming metadata only.
identity_bridge_rules.known_JANUS_document_universe: Bridge keys are compared only against a separately frozen identity list; transcription content from mwenge/SigLA is not loaded by this gate.

deterministic_partition.dataset_binding: selection hash includes source_id, edition_id and SHA-256 of canonical sorted acquired-file SHA list

ADAPTER_VALIDATION.content_access_after_freeze: Allowed only under separately frozen R3B-2 source-adapter grammar/validation spec.
ADAPTER_VALIDATION.purpose: Learn whether the source-specific adapter losslessly represents notation, uncertainty, damage, layout and token typing.

SCIENTIFIC_HOLDOUT.content_access_after_freeze: Forbidden until R3B-2 adapter is frozen and a later claim-bearing replication spec explicitly unlocks a deterministic subset.
SCIENTIFIC_HOLDOUT.purpose: Prevent adapter development and overlap selection from consuming the same alternate-editorial readings later used as replication evidence.

forbidden: do not inspect alternate-source transcription to choose overlap documents
do not search alternate source for ku-ro, si, AB41 or any prior JANUS near-miss before holdout is frozen
do not use mwenge/SigLA reading agreement to resolve document identity collisions
do not replace failed or inconvenient adapter-validation documents
do not move a scientific-holdout document into adapter validation after content is observed
do not call R3B-1 external replication; it freezes identity and blindness only

next_if_successful.action: Freeze the acquired source's notation/tokenization/layout grammar and implement an adapter into JANUS-LINEAR-TRANSCRIPTION-IR-v1.0 using only the ADAPTER_VALIDATION pool. The SCIENTIFIC_HOLDOUT remains inaccessible to adapter tuning.
